result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The scoping and convention tests pass, but I didn't add tests for the new cases (`.htm` pages, a real `app.js` or `MyAssembly.xml`, `build-gradle.js`), so those matches are untested.

- **Generated HTML rules:** The pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator patterns had `(html|html|xhtml)`, a duplicated `html`. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match as well as `.html` and `.xhtml`.
- **Generated JS and .NET XML rules:** The path patterns were `.*/[.]js` and `.*/[.]xml`, which only matched a file literally named `.js` or `.xml`. They are now `.*[.]js` and `.*[.]xml`, so `app.js` and `MyAssembly.xml` are covered. The content and line-count checks are unchanged.
- **Gradle JS rule:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` lands in build-and-deployment.

The `.js` rule still needs a `// Generated by …` first line and the `.xml` rule a `<doc>` line in the first 2 lines, so hand-written `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of the generated scope. The existing `.html`/`.xhtml` and `build.gradle` matches are untouched. Nothing is committed.
